name: AutoTools
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.

description: AutoTools is a Minecraft mod that allows you to automatically switch to the best tool for blocks/mobs with the press of a button. It looks through your whole inventory and choses the best tool according to mining level/speed, damage and enchantments.
